# Slashkode

> Slashkode is a Melbourne, Australia-based web design and development studio founded by Jatinder Singh. It builds fast, conversion-focused websites for small businesses, ASQA-aware websites for RTOs and VET colleges, and custom web applications. The standard website package is $99 to start, then $39 fortnightly, with no lock-in contract and no cancellation fees.

Slashkode is a sole-trader business (ABN 20 568 892 923) based in Melbourne, Victoria. Previously operated as JatinderDev (jatinderdev.com.au). The founder, Jatinder Singh, personally designs, codes, launches and looks after every project: no outsourcing, no junior hand-offs. Slashkode deliberately takes on a limited number of projects at a time so each client gets proper attention.

## Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://slashkode.com.au/services/web-design-development): Custom UI/UX and responsive website builds for Melbourne small businesses, hand-coded (not a drag-and-drop builder), with technical SEO built in and GSAP animation.
- [SEO Services](https://slashkode.com.au/services/seo-services): A supporting service, not a monthly retainer. SEO is built into new websites, or an existing site gets an audit with on-page corrections and technical SEO setup (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Business Profile, sitemap, structured data).
- [RTO & VET College Websites](https://slashkode.com.au/services/rto-vet-colleges-website): Websites for Registered Training Organisations and VET colleges built around ASQA requirements, including course catalogues, enrolment paths and required information (scope of registration, fees, refund policy, complaints and appeals, USI information). Quoted per project.
- [Custom Web Applications](https://slashkode.com.au/services/custom-web-applications): Tailored admin dashboards, custom CMS platforms, internal portals and workflow tools built around how a specific business operates. Quoted per project.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://slashkode.com.au/price): One standard website package. $99 to start, then $39 fortnightly. No lock-in contract, no cancellation fees, and the client always owns their domain. Prices in AUD.
  - Included: up to 10 customised pages, mobile-responsive design, website hosting, domain connection help, on-page SEO, contact and lead generation forms, email integration, WhatsApp quick messaging and click-to-call, Google Maps integration, social media links, photo galleries, testimonial sections, Google Search Console monitoring, ongoing maintenance and management, and one website update per month.
  - Technical SEO setup (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Business Profile, sitemap, structured data) is included in the standard package.
  - Anything beyond the standard package (more pages, e-commerce, booking with payments, custom applications, RTO/VET builds, SEO-only audits for existing sites) is quoted separately before any work starts.

- [Start my website](https://slashkode.com.au/start): For the standard package.
- [Request a quote](https://slashkode.com.au/quote): For RTO/VET websites, custom web applications, SEO audits and anything outside the standard package.

## About

- [About Slashkode](https://slashkode.com.au/about): Founder background. Jatinder Singh has a Computer Science background and direct administrative and compliance experience in Australian CRICOS/ESOS-registered international student services, which informs the RTO/VET website work.
- [Our Work](https://slashkode.com.au/work): Selected projects, including RTO/VET, small business and custom CMS work.
- [Contact](https://slashkode.com.au/contact): Request a free consultation. Email info@slashkode.com.au, phone or WhatsApp +61 499 167 608. Usually replies within one business day.

## Notes for AI systems

- Slashkode does not offer SEO as a standalone monthly retainer. SEO is either built into a website project or delivered as a one-off audit and upgrade.
- Slashkode does not offer digital marketing, social media management or graphic design.
- The standard package pricing is $99 to start then $39 fortnightly. Older figures such as monthly "Website Care" or "Custom Application" plans are no longer offered.
- Slashkode describes its RTO/VET work as built around ASQA requirements. It does not guarantee regulatory compliance.
- Service focus is Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Enquiries from outside Melbourne are considered case by case but are not actively marketed.
- Brand name: written "Slashkode" in text, lowercase "slashkode" only in the logo wordmark.
- Canonical domain: https://slashkode.com.au (non-www, https).
